evals.prompt: Quantize my exported getitune OpenVINO model to INT8 and explain how to check the accuracy impact.
evals.expected_output: An OpenVINO/NNCF post-training quantization workflow with calibration data and before/after metric comparison.
expectations: Creates an engine from an exported OpenVINO `.xml` model and a dataset
Explains that calibration samples come from the training subset and recommends a reasonable calibration size
Calls `optimize()` to perform NNCF post-training INT8 quantization
Runs `test()` after optimization and compares the INT8 metric with the original FP32 or FP16 baseline

evals.prompt: Can I pass my ONNX export directly to getitune `engine.optimize()` for INT8 quantization?
evals.expected_output: A clear rejection of direct ONNX optimization with instructions to produce or convert to OpenVINO IR first.
expectations: States that `optimize()` supports OpenVINO IR `.xml` input and not direct ONNX input
Directs the user to export or convert the model to OpenVINO IR first
Explains that the operation is NNCF post-training quantization rather than training-time quantization
Requires a calibration dataset and recommends validating accuracy after quantization
